newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Feb 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Feb 25.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
- Banner headline reads: "Eternal glory to our beloved Comrade Deng Xiaoping."
- A frontpage report says more than 100,000 people paid their final respects to Deng Xiaoping.
- More than one million pictures of Deng Xiaoping have been printed since his death last Wednesday to meet a surge in demand.
- A solemn memorial for Deng Xiaoping will be held in Beijing's Great Hall of the People on Tuesday.
- Chinese news organisations met in Beijing on Monday to discuss how to better publicise Deng Xiaoping's theories.
- Some one million post and telecommunications workers are grieving over Deng Xiaoping's death, pledging to speed up development of their sector.
